big_case.notes: Plenary grant on whether a bankruptcy court may refuse to compel arbitration of Section 362(k) automatic-stay damages claims, over a 4th/2nd Circuit split. This would be the Court's first word on McMahon in bankruptcy, and it reaches arbitration clauses in consumer-credit contracts across consumer bankruptcies nationwide. It is a significant business and statutory case with low general public salience.
